content.title: 被动语态综合·各时态被动 + 非谓语被动 速查
content.intro: 被动语态 = be 的相应形式 + 过去分词(done)。主语是动作的承受者(被…)时用被动。判断口诀:先看主语是否‘被动作’,再由时间标志/句法环境决定 be 用什么形式。

headers: 被动形式 / 标志 / 例句
rows: 一般现在
am/is/are done(today, usually):The book is loved by readers.
一般过去
was/were done(ago, last…, in 1997):It was written in 1997.
一般将来
will be done(tomorrow, next…):A film will be made next year.
现在完成
has/have been done(already, so far, since):It has been translated.
过去完成
had been done(by the time…, by 1997):It had been finished.
现在进行
is/are being done(now, Look!):Morrie is being weakened.
过去进行
was/were being done(while…, when… came):It was being recorded.
情态被动
must/should/can + be done:Values must be chosen by yourself.
不定式被动
to be done(need/want/ask + to be done):It needs to be passed on.
动名词被动
being done(介词 despite/after/without/by 后):Despite being weakened…

specialRules.rule: 主语是动作的发出者 → 仍用主动,别误用被动
specialRules.mark: Mitch visited Morrie.(Mitch 主动探望)

specialRules.rule: 主语是动作的承受者、常带 by… → 用被动
specialRules.mark: Morrie was visited by Mitch.(莫里被探望)

specialRules.rule: 情态/将来后的被动必须保留 be:must be done / will be done
specialRules.mark: should be read √ / should read ×(若主语被读)

specialRules.rule: 介词后用动名词被动 being done,不能用 to be done
specialRules.mark: Despite being weakened √ / Despite to be weakened ×

why: 被动语态把‘动作的承受者’放到主语位置,强调被影响的人或物;当动作的发出者不重要、未知或泛指‘人们’时,常省略 by 短语。
无论哪种时态,变化的只是 be 这个部分;后面的过去分词 done 不变——抓住‘be 随时态变、done 不变’就不易错。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:给出动词原形,按时间标志/语境填正确的被动形式(is done / was done / has been done / is being done / had been done)。
非谓语:need/ask + to be done、介词 + being done、情态 + be done 的被动易漏 be 或 being。
主动 vs 被动:先判断主语是施动者还是受动者,再决定用不用被动(尤其 happen/rise/appear 等不及物动词无被动)。

examVsReal.exam: The window is being cleaned.(考试强调进行被动)
examVsReal.note: 口语里常用主动 + someone/they 来代替被动,显得更自然

examVsReal.exam: It is said that he is wise.(考试爱考 it is said/believed that…)
examVsReal.note: 考试偏好被动套语,日常更常用 people say…
